headline.text: L3 cleared *7 items* including a belt replacement and Truffle Line buildup that cut attainment short — 3 open items remain.

per_plant_summary.L1: No activity in the last 24 hours.
per_plant_summary.L2: No activity in the last 24 hours.
per_plant_summary.L3: Busy weekend run across ML1, ML4, and Truffle Line. ML4 belt replacement and TG3 conveyor repair cleared same-day. Truffle Line stopped depositing early at 21:50 to address Cavanna 1 chocolate buildup impacting seal quality — cleaning completed overnight and line ready for Monday. C4 belt drifting north remains a recurring issue tied to worn scrapers.

resolved.title: TG4C12 belt ripped down center on ML4
resolved.summary: M270 belt torn with risk of fiber contamination to chocolate bars — Rose approved replacement if spare available.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 20:00 — "TG4C12 (M270) belt has been replaced" (Spencer Andrus). 4 M270 belts remain in spare inventory.

resolved.title: Cavanna 1 chocolate buildup on rails preventing proper FW seals
resolved.summary: Heavy chocolate buildup on Cavanna 1 rails blocking individual piece sealing and preventing attainment goal — 2nd shift stopped depositing at 21:50 for early shutdown and deep clean.
resolved.resolution: Cleared overnight — line completed level 2 cleaning, passed all ATP tests, and ready for Monday startup by 07:10 (Janeth Sanchez).

resolved.title: Bent water connection on ML1 pump block preventing hopper installation
resolved.summary: Water connection bent and blocking fit — maintenance notified and hopper installation completed within 1 hour.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 14:36 — "The installation of the hopper was completed" (Imperial).

resolved.title: Pallet placed on unapproved racking
resolved.summary: Pallet loaded on racking not yet approved by fire marshal or city — needed immediate removal to maintain safety compliance.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 16:53 — "The pallet was pulled down" (Marcos Montano).

resolved.title: TG3 Z-conveyor needs repair on ML4
resolved.summary: Z-conveyor flagged for repair during 2nd shift — maintenance called and issue addressed.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 22:35 — "TG3 belts are running well" (Spencer Andrus).

resolved.title: TG3 M159 belt drifting south during startup on ML4
resolved.summary: Belt drifting during 15-minute test run on 3rd shift — maintenance called to adjust tracking.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 07:37 — "TG3 belt tested for 15 min" after maintenance adjustment (Phillip Perez).

resolved.title: 10264 salted cream inventory missing on ML4
resolved.summary: Shift exchange listed wrong item number (10256 vs. 10264) causing confusion about expiring pallet location.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 23:36 — Tyson verified the pallet pulled earlier was correct 10264 expiring 11/29; shift exchange had typo.

needs_attention.title: Truffle Line C4 belt drifting north repeatedly
needs_attention.summary: C4 belt shifted north at least 5 times on 2nd shift — root cause identified as worn scrapers beneath C3 and C4 allowing chocolate buildup on rollers, but scrapers not yet replaced.
needs_attention.status: Maintenance called multiple times; Bojana identified worn scrapers and buildup as root cause at 15:07, but no scraper replacement initiated by end of shift.

needs_attention.title: Dry ice pellets unavailable for ML4
needs_attention.summary: Preston unable to source dry ice pellets in time — needed before Wednesday night, recommended MRCs reach out to purchasing Monday.
needs_attention.status: Confirmed unavailable at 16:23; Shane to follow up with purchasing Monday.

needs_attention.title: Damaged 35 gram mold on ML1
needs_attention.summary: One 35 gram mold found damaged during 2nd shift — no mention of replacement or removal from service.
needs_attention.status: Reported at 15:59 with photo; no follow-up posted.
